dedupe_keys.name: ceos database earth observation handbook catalogue of earth observation satellite missions instruments and measurements

description: The CEOS Database, published with the Earth Observation Handbook of the Committee on Earth Observation Satellites, is a catalogue of Earth observation satellites run by space agencies. It holds searchable tables and alphabetical indexes of current, future and completed missions and of instruments, each with summary pages; an overview of measurement categories and detailed measurements indexed in the database; customisable measurement timelines linked to missions; recent launch activity; datasets and recent data releases; and browsing by agency. Special portals cover greenhouse gas satellite missions, ESA third party missions and wildfire satellite missions. Coverage: civil Earth observation missions of CEOS member agencies worldwide, past, present and planned. Format and access: interactive web tables and summary pages; free. Licence: not stated beyond copyright CEOS 2026. Caveats: the database describes missions and instruments, not the satellite data themselves, and whether tables can be exported was not checked. Simulation uses: finding which satellites and instruments measure a variable, such as flood extent, fire or soil moisture, and for how long, when planning hazard monitoring for infrastructure. Related records: CelesTrak (data-celestrak-gp-satcat) gives orbital elements of the same satellites, and Space-Track (data-space-track-satcat-gp) the official catalogue.
